nodes.label: TimescaleDB
nodes.rationale: Single database replacing dual-database architecture (QuestDB + PostgreSQL). Handles both time-series (hypertables) and relational data via regular PostgreSQL tables. Single target for all Flyway migrations.

nodes.label: Apache Arrow IPC
nodes.rationale: Eliminates JSON serialization bottleneck for time-series arrays. Critical for AIC loop and batch analytics between Java and Python.

nodes.label: Virtual Threads + Spring MVC
nodes.rationale: Primary concurrency runtime. Shared service layer uses interfaces so WebFlux adapters can be added later as a separate module without rewriting business logic. No dual-mode parity requirement.

nodes.label: Direct FRED/NY Fed Java Clients
nodes.rationale: Removes OpenBB sidecar from the critical ILI ingestion path. OpenBB reserved for econometrics only.

nodes.label: Proxy Divergence Guard
nodes.rationale: Detects T-Bill/SOFR dislocation during flight-to-quality events and suppresses stale proxy signals.

nodes.label: Dynamic Weighting for Zero-Variance
nodes.rationale: Redistributes weight among valid components instead of masking stale data as neutral (0.0). Zero-variance components return NaN rather than 0.0.

nodes.label: FINOS CDM Subset Projection
nodes.rationale: Canonical instrument model for Repo, SOFR, T-Bill, equity. Reduces ad-hoc enum proliferation in API contracts and schema. Subset only to limit complexity and boilerplate.

nodes.label: FINOS Perspective
nodes.rationale: High-performance grid/chart for correlation matrix, signal log, liquidity heatmap. Complements D3.js for data-heavy panels. Confined to tabular/grid contexts.

nodes.label: Pre-Computed KPI Views
nodes.rationale: Rolling correlation and beta pre-computed as TimescaleDB continuous aggregates. Reduces per-cycle TA-Lib computation load for stable-window KPIs.

nodes.label: CDM Adapter in Ingestion Layer
nodes.rationale: Raw data mapped to CDM objects at the ingestion boundary via CdmAdapter. Computation engine consumes CDM-typed data regardless of source, preventing source-specific field mismatch in ILI calculation.

nodes.label: Wait-Free Ingestion (Off-Heap)
nodes.rationale: TimescaleDbWriter uses off-heap, GC-friendly buffer patterns. Chronicle Queue configured for memory-mapped files on dedicated NVMe partition. Prevents GC-induced latency spikes during market events.

nodes.label: Real-Time Aggregates (materialized_only=false)
nodes.rationale: Transparent live+materialized data merge in TimescaleDB eliminates the 1-minute aggregate blind spot.

nodes.label: Chronicle Queue on Dedicated Storage
nodes.rationale: tmpfs or separate NVMe partition prevents I/O contention with TimescaleDB.
